scope: Direct read-only mounted tool documentation and one live models_explore list; no generation, upload, training, deployment, project creation or spending

documentation_reads.observed: Returns CMS preset ids/names/previews; selected preset is resolved via resolve_explainer_preset for style media_id. Does not establish a universal 10-second block rule.
Model-specific duration_range or durations and typed parameters are returned; action get is required for exact selected model constraints.
Required type website/app/game and category; app template required. Create mutates site/repo. Deploy ships live and publish lists already-live production; these boundaries cannot be merged.

Training uses 5-20 confirmed/reference images, name, explicit authorized identity intent; trained Soul only soul_2/soul_cinematic and one soul_id per generation. Local paths are not accepted training references. Single-image/multiple-subject Elements path is distinct.

live_read.limit: Subset only; not a complete catalog or a guarantee for an unselected model/preset. Raw result retained in leader session transcript. API documentation inspection is not proof of successful media generation.
